title.zh: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China
title.en: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China

current_state.zh: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.
current_state.en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.
